questions.text: Do you place connectable software or hardware on the EU market?
Is it only a hosted service, with nothing running on the user's side?
Is it a medical device, vehicle, aviation or marine product?
Do you make it, or market it under your name?

outcomes.reason: The Act covers products with digital elements. Confirm with your adviser.
A hosted service alone is outside the Act; NIS2 may apply instead. Confirm with your adviser.
Supply outside a commercial activity is outside the Act. Confirm with your adviser.
The sector's own EU law applies. Confirm with your adviser.
These rows are manufacturer duties; other roles have duties not listed here.
